scientific_question: Does one additional non-reserved public PoolFire train trajectory at the same 33 kW power but a different fire size establish mutual target-free support for the deployment-visible camera state, without opening any reserved holdout, validation, or test trajectory?
scope: Post-open train-split support diagnostic. PoolFire train rho is used only to synthesize the frozen virtual-BOS observations. No Krylov target, reconstruction target, validation truth, test truth, model fit, prediction, fallback, physical replay, wall/RSS benchmark, curved ray, or real BOST claim is allowed.

feature_contract.primary: The frozen 45-value camera feature: 2x2 signed DCT plus relative RMS for observation, exact K1 residual and exact K1 detector dual, followed by the reported 18-value pose token.
feature_contract.diagnostic_control: Within each sample, center and RMS-scale each of the 27 observable channels over active cameras while preserving all 18 reported-pose channels. This target-free control cannot replace the primary decision.

support_contract.distance: RMS Euclidean distance over fit-standardized camera features.
support_contract.fit_only_normalization: Each sample has total weight one, distributed uniformly over its active cameras.
support_contract.support_threshold: fit-only higher 90th percentile of exact cross-trajectory nearest-neighbor RMS distances
support_contract.original_anchor_comparison: For each of the five parent heldouts, keep the original four-trajectory normalization and threshold fixed; compare the original candidate pool against the same pool plus p33-s03. Therefore any changed support flag is attributable only to the added train trajectory.
support_contract.new_trajectory_comparison: Hold out p33-s03 and use all five parent trajectories for normalization, threshold and candidate support.

non_exchangeable_decision_rule: If any parent binding, train-pair binding, perturbation roster, one-step exact-call ledger, target-free feature, exact-neighbor result, input immutability check, or independent recomputation fails, return INCONCLUSIVE_EXPANDED_TRAIN_SUPPORT_V152.

Return PASS_P33_SAME_POWER_MUTUAL_SUPPORT_V152 only if the primary raw camera45 state reaches at least 0.9 support for every 5/7/9/12-camera stratum of both p33-s01 and p33-s03, and at least one previously unsupported p33-s01 row is rescued specifically by p33-s03.
Otherwise return FAIL_P33_SAME_POWER_MUTUAL_SUPPORT_V152. The within-set normalized control is diagnostic only and cannot rescue the primary decision.
A primary pass authorizes only a separately frozen broader train-coverage audit. It does not authorize a predictor, physical replay, resource gate, external holdout, neural operator, or GPU.
A primary failure closes one-trajectory p33 coverage expansion as an explanation; do not rescue it with a larger model.
